prose.subject: URGENT: NEAR Payout Account Update for INV-83284
prose.body:
Hi Priya,

I hope your week is going well. I am reaching out urgently because our treasury team has just migrated our primary vendor payout account on the NEAR network to a new wallet structure to streamline our settlement processes.

Please note that for our next payment cycle, specifically for invoice INV-83284 in the amount of 6357.84 USDC, the funds must be directed to the new account: 5tanmerefreight84.testnet

We are currently finalizing our quarterly reconciliation, and processing this invoice before end-of-day is critical to avoid a temporary hold on your vendor status in our portal. The old account will be deprecated after today’s close, so any funds sent there may face a slight delay in crediting back to us.

Could you please confirm once the transfer has been initiated? If you have already scheduled the payment via the standard portal, a manual override to the new address is required.

Thank you for your prompt attention to this. We value our partnership with Corvane Labs and appreciate your agility in handling this transition.

Best regards,

Lena Adeyemi
Senior Accounts Payable Manager
Stanmere Freight
